name: adr183-continuation-native-46
result: Retained failure after ADR-193 step 2b passed natively: the real applier created the federation's four auth roles and policies, the connector PKI roles and the federation audit transit key in one phase-3 apply, the continuation filled the federation audit Secret from the inbox and verified every federation path through the inspection token (federation/verify). The owner launch then stopped before any effect at projection.current-native (unavailable), the third launch-phase native-check failure (runs 35, 41, 46); the code now carries its class, elapsed time and remaining budget.
